assign.outcome: **Fixed** the zero-size/measure collapse in the wall-vs-rail comparison row on /framework/ext/catalog/ at 390. Root cause: default flex (flex:0 1 auto, min-width:auto) let the rail demo (card-filled, big min-content) refuse to shrink and starved the wall demo (a bare paragraph) down to a 42px box holding a 6px-wide text column — worst at 390 but present at every width (198px vs 525px at 1280, no rule tripped, just an unfair comparison). Fixed with the existing .flex.auto utility on the row in page.js (one class, no new CSS) — flex:1 1 var(--column); min-width:0 makes both demo.app boxes share the row equally and shrink together. Verified: zero-size and the high-severity measure finding gone at 390 and 720; no findings lost at 1280/3440 (score improved 78→80 at 1280); the comparison now reads as a fair comparison at every width, not merely unbroken at 390. Recorded as a fifth Traps bullet in ext/catalog/readme.md beside the other four.
